title: 自我對準接觸孔製程
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 接觸與套刻
stages.description: 在「接觸與套刻」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for contacts and overlay, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 自對準的含義
steps.objective: 完成「自對準的含義」的因果圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define self-alignment, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：自對準的含義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define self-alignment. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「自對準的含義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define self-alignment and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「自對準的含義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define self-alignment: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 自對準的含義的原理
knowledge.text: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。
knowledge.textEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 自對準保護來自材料選擇性及結構重疊，套刻偏移仍可能縮小落點或增加角落暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Self-alignment relies on material selectivity and overlap; overlay shifts can still reduce landing area or expose corners.

quiz.question: 評估「自對準的含義」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define self-alignment?
options: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。 自對準保護來自材料選擇性及結構重疊，套刻偏移仍可能縮小落點或增加角落暴露。
quiz.explanationEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. Self-alignment relies on material selectivity and overlap; overlay shifts can still reduce landing area or expose corners.

steps.title: 接觸目標區
steps.objective: 完成「接觸目標區」的對照表，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for mark contact targets, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：接觸目標區。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：接觸需連到源汲極且避開閘金屬。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Mark contact targets. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Contacts must reach source-drain while avoiding gate metal. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接觸需連到源汲極且避開閘金屬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Contacts must reach source-drain while avoiding gate metal. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「接觸目標區」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for mark contact targets and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「接觸目標區」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for mark contact targets: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 閘帽與間隔層
steps.objective: 完成「閘帽與間隔層」的敏感度草圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for assign caps and spacers, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘帽與間隔層。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：閘帽與間隔層共同提供蝕刻保護。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign caps and spacers. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Gate caps and spacers jointly provide etch protection. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘帽與間隔層共同提供蝕刻保護。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「閘帽與間隔層」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assign caps and spacers: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 套刻容忍圖
steps.objective: 完成「套刻容忍圖」的故障判別表，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for draw overlay-tolerance maps, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：套刻容忍圖。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：幾何容忍需同時計入孔寬與保護層剩餘量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂一維落點：目標區寬 40、孔寬 20 單位；先求完全落入的中心偏移上限，再討論為何選擇性保護只能改變部分失效邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw overlay-tolerance maps. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Tolerance includes opening width and remaining protective material. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical 1D landing: target width 40 and opening width 20 units. Find the center-offset limit for full landing, then explain why selective protection changes only some failure boundaries.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「幾何容忍需同時計入孔寬與保護層剩餘量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Tolerance includes opening width and remaining protective material. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「套刻容忍圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw overlay-tolerance maps and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「套刻容忍圖」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for draw overlay-tolerance maps: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 縱橫比
steps.objective: 完成「縱橫比」的量測規劃，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for assess aspect ratio, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：縱橫比。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：深窄孔的傳輸與底部去除不同於平面。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess aspect ratio. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Transport and bottom removal in deep holes differ from planar surfaces. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「深窄孔的傳輸與底部去除不同於平面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「縱橫比」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for assess aspect ratio: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：材料選擇比。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：高選擇比仍需知道保護層可接受損失。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define material selectivity. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: High selectivity still requires an allowable protection-layer loss. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高選擇比仍需知道保護層可接受損失。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

quiz.explanationEn: High selectivity still requires an allowable protection-layer loss. Self-alignment relies on material selectivity and overlap; overlay shifts can still reduce landing area or expose corners.
